blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: UTF-8's role as the de facto encoding standard in language models introduces cross-lingual inequities due to its variable-length design. However, the effect that this encoding choice has on model performance remains largely unexamined. In this work, we investigate how text encoding impacts the performance of byte-level language models, comparing UTF-8 with a wide range of other encoding strategies, including other Unicode-based approaches, language-specific encodings, and our own customized encodings. To facilitate our analysis, we propose Aether: a hybrid encoding scheme that uses script-specific encodings for our target setting while maintaining full Unicode coverage through UTF-8 fallbacks, using this framework to model four orthographically diverse languages. Surprisingly, we find that while languages with information-dense characters (Chinese, Korean) significantly benefit from compressive encodings, languages whose characters carry less information individually (Georgian, Tamil) are largely insensitive to encoding choice. In light of these findings, we argue that text encoding should be a language-specific design decision, rather than a universal default.
blocks.zh: UTF-8作为语言模型中事实上的编码标准,由于其可变长度设计,引入了跨语言的不平等. 然而,这种编码选择对模型性能的影响基本上仍未得到审查。 在这项工作中,我们调查了文本编码如何影响字节级语言模型的性能,将UTF-8与其他广泛的编码策略进行比较,包括其他以Unicode为基础的方法,语言特有编码,以及我们自己的定制编码. 为了方便我们的分析,我们提议了以太:一个混合编码方案,它使用脚本专用的编码来设定我们的目标,同时通过UTF-8回落来保持全Unicode覆盖,利用这个框架来模拟四种正文不同的语言. 令人惊讶的是,我们发现虽然具有信息密集字符(中文,韩文)的语言大大受益于压缩编码,但其字符携带的信息较少的个别语言(格鲁吉亚语,泰米尔语)对编码选择大多不敏感. 鉴于这些发现,我们主张文本编码应该是针对语言的具体设计决定,而不是普遍的默认.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Subword tokenization (i.e. BPE; Gage, 1994 ; Sennrich et al., 2016 ) has long been the dominant approach to tokenization ( Mielke et al., 2021 ) , but there is growing interest in byte-level tokenization ( Tay et al., 2022 ; Xue et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 , inter alia ) as a way to overcome the shortcomings of subword tokenization ( Bostrom and Durrett, 2020 ; Beinborn and Pinter, 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Chai et al., 2024 ) .
While these methods aim to reduce inductive biases carried by subword tokens, the inherent biases of the bytes used as the bases for language models instead are often overlooked.
The de facto standard for converting text into bytes in modern computing applications is UTF-8, a variable length encoding scheme capable of expressing all Unicode codepoints using 1 ∼ \sim 4 bytes; due to its ubiquity, it is also the primary method for converting text into language modeling inputs. However, UTF-8 introduces inefficiencies ( Moon et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) and unfairness ( Petrov et al., 2023 ; Arnett et al., 2024 ) , leading some to argue that it is suboptimal for NLP applications van der Goot (2026) .

blocks.en:
Recent work, such as MYTE ( Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ) and SCRIPT ( Land and Arnett, 2025 ) , propose new encoding strategies designed to address fairness between languages.
However, these studies are limited to a single alternative encoding designed to improve the UTF-8 baseline on a specific dimension, leaving many aspects of how encoding choice affects language modeling unexplored.
In this work, we present a systematic comparison of encoding methods for byte-level language modeling, based on a wide range (16) of encoding methods spanning Unicode-based encodings, language-specific encodings, and our own proposed custom encodings (Figure 1 ).
To enable controlled comparisons within a target script, we propose Aether tokenizers (Alternative Encoding Tokenizers for Hybrid Encoding Representations), which apply script-specific encodings when relevant while applying UTF-8 as a back-off encoding for other text.
Using Aether tokenizers, we train “byte”-level models on four orthographically distinct languages (Chinese, Korean, Georgian, Tamil) with 38 unique language-encoding pairs.

blocks.en:
Our experiments reveal two distinct patterns. For Chinese and Korean, encoding choice has a clear impact on performance, with more compressive encodings yielding significantly better results. In contrast, all encodings perform similarly for Georgian and Tamil, even when their compression rates differ by up to ∼ 7 × {\sim}7\times and ∼ 8 × {\sim}8\times , respectively. We hypothesize that these divergent results stem from differences in the orthographic granularity of the underlying scripts. Specifically, when characters individually encode meaningful information (as in Chinese and Korean), compression appears to heavily impact performance, while characters that carry little information in isolation (like Tamil and Georgian) are largely insensitive to encoding selection.
Given these script-specific trends, we argue that text encoding should be treated as a deliberate design choice that accounts for these properties rather than accepted as a universal default.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The drawbacks of subword tokenizers are often cited as motivations to use atomic units of text as tokens, in the form of characters ( Clark et al., 2022 ; Gao et al., 2020 ; Lee et al., 2017 ) or bytes ( Xue et al., 2022 ; Neitemeier et al., 2025 ; Hwang et al., 2025 ) . 2 2 2 Characters and bytes are often used interchangeably in this context. Several works use “character-level” in writing while implementing on the byte-level ( Al-Rfou et al., 2019 ; Choe et al., 2019 ; Tay et al., 2022 ) . However, these approaches have seen limited adoption, which Libovický et al. (2022) attribute to their increased computational cost and underperformance to subword counterparts.
On the other hand, Edman et al. (2024) identify benefits of byte-level models in low-resource MT scenarios, and argue lower efficiency should be seen as a tradeoff. Minixhofer et al. (2026) note that such models are advantageous in domains that benefit from character understanding, such as code and biological sequences.
While byte-level models have some promising advantages, the literature typically defaults to the UTF-8 encoding.

另一方面,Edman等人(2024年)在低资源MT情景中确定了字节级模型的效益,并主张低效率应被视为取舍. Minixhofer等人(2026年)指出,这种模型在从字符理解中受益的领域,如代码和生物序列中是有利的.
虽然字节级模型有一些有希望的优点,但文献通常默认为UTF-8编码.

blocks.en:
Past work discuss how tokenization length can vary greatly between languages when conveying the same information ( Ahia et al., 2023 ; Petrov et al., 2023 ) . Arnett et al. (2024) identify how UTF-8 variable byte lengths can systematically distort text dataset sizes.
UTF-8 uses variable byte-lengths to encode different scripts, with higher Unicode code points requiring more bytes.
Basic Latin characters take up early code points represented by single bytes, while other language scripts are encoded with multiple bytes per character.
A script’s encoding efficiency therefore depends on its position within Unicode, as earlier code points are encoded as two bytes (e.g. Cyrillic, U+0400–U+04FF) while later code points require three bytes (e.g. Tamil, U+0B80–U+0BFF) or more.
Furthermore, two-byte UTF-8 sequences can represent only up to 1,920 code points, which is insufficient for large script blocks, such as CJK Unified Ideographs (20,992 characters) or Hangul Syllables (11,172 characters).
In this work, we experiment with Chinese, Korean, Tamil, and Georgian, all of whose scripts fall within the three-byte encoding range.
blocks.zh:
过去的工作讨论了在传递相同信息时,不同语言之间的符号化长度如何大相径庭(Ahia等,2023;Petrov等,2023.). Arnett等 (2024)识别出UTF-8可变字节长度如何能够系统地扭曲文本数据集大小.
UTF-8使用可变字节长度来编码不同的脚本,更高的Unicode代码点需要更多的字节.
基本拉丁字母取用以单字节为代表的早期代码点,而其他语言脚本则以每个字符多字节来编码.
因此,一个脚本的编码效率取决于它在Unicode中的位置,因为早期的代码点被编码为两个字节(如Cyrilic,U+0400–U+04FF)而后期的代码点需要三个字节(如泰米尔语,U+0B80–U+0BFF)或更多.
此外,双字节的UTF-8序列只能代表多达1,920个代码点,对于CJK United Ideographers(20,992个字符)或Hangul Syllables(11,172个字符)等大型脚本块来说是不够的.
在这部作品中,我们用中国人,朝鲜人,泰米尔人和格鲁吉亚人进行实验,他们的脚本都属于"三字码"范围.

blocks.en:
Previous works explore different encoding methods, either by creating new indexing strategies or modifying UTF-8. Limisiewicz et al. (2024) propose MYTE encoding, which converts redundant bytes in the UTF-8 bytespace to encode morphological units. Land and Arnett (2025) propose SCRIPT encoding, where all Unicode characters are encoded in two-part representations of block-indexing pairs.
Few works specifically target the large character inventories in the CJK Unified Ideographs and Hangul Syllables blocks. Kim et al. (2026a) suggest representing these code points with UTF-16 encoding, which results in two bytes per character.
Similarly, Moon et al. (2025) compress such code points to two 9-bit units by deduplicating redundancies and redistributing the indexing bits of their UTF-8 byte representations.
Other works leverage properties specific to a target script, such as decomposability or glyph information ( Stratos, 2017 ; Moon and Okazaki, 2020 ; Si et al., 2023 ) .
We build on these approaches to systematically evaluate many encoding schemes on language model performance.

很少有作品专门针对CJK United Ideographers和Hangul Syllables块中的大型字符目录. Kim等 (2026a)建议用UTF-16编码代表这些代码点,结果每个字符有两个字节.
同样地,Moon等人(2025年)通过去除冗余并重新分配其UTF-8字节表示的索引比特,压缩了这样的代码指向了两个9位单位.

我们利用这些方法系统地评价许多关于语言模型性能的编码方案。

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the encoding methods tested in our experiments (Table 1 ).

blocks.en:
We consider an encoding to be any mapping of natural language text into an atomic basis for modeling (potentially ranging from bit-based representations to multi-character units).
Critically, we do not restrict ourselves to byte- or bit-aligned units; an encoding may use any indexing unit and vocabulary size we define.
We group the considered encodings as follows: Unicode-based encodings (§ 3.1 ); language-specific encodings designed to represent a single script (§ 3.2 ); and CuTF, our customized indexing scheme that efficiently encodes a script at a fixed length (§ 3.3 ).
Examples of encodings are illustrated in Figure 1 .

关键是,我们不仅限于字节或比特相配单位;编码可能使用我们定义的任何索引单位和词汇大小.
我们将考虑的编码归类如下:基于Unicode的编码(§ 3.1);旨在代表单一脚本的针对语言的编码(§ 3.2);以及CutF, 即我们的定制索引计划,它高效地将一个脚本以固定长度编码(§ 3.3).

blocks.en: 3.1 Unicode-based Encodings
blocks.zh: 3.1 基于 Unicode 的编码

blocks.en:
Unicode is a character encoding standard that unifies previously separate character sets by assigning each character a unique code point.
The code points are converted into code units through UTF (Unicode Transformation Format) encodings: UTF-8 uses 8-bit bytes as code units while UTF-16 uses 16-bit byte-pairs as code units.
blocks.zh:
Unicode是一个字符编码标准,它通过给每个字符分配一个独特的代码点来统一先前独立的字符集.
代码点通过UTF(Unicode Transform Format)编码被转换为代码单位:UTF-8使用8位字节作为代码单位,而UTF-16使用16位字节作为代码单位.

blocks.en:
While UTF-8 has 256 total byte values in its inventory, only a subset of these values are used to encode multi-byte characters.
Each UTF-8 multi-byte character encoding is composed of two types of bytes: the starting byte and the continuation bytes.
Starting bytes use part of their beginning bits to indicate the number of continuation bytes that follow while the remaining bits are used for indexing.
For instance, in the byte 0xEC ( 11101100 ) the 4-bit prefix ( 1110 ) signals that it begins a three-byte sequence, while the remaining 4 bits ( 1100 ) carry indexing information.
Continuation bytes have a fixed 2-bit prefix ( 10 ), and use the remaining 6 bits to carry indexing information.
Consequently, only 16 of the 24 bits in a three-byte UTF-8 encoding of a code point contain indexing information.
blocks.zh:
虽然UTF-8在其目录中拥有256个总字节值,但这些值中只有子集用于编码多字节字符.
每个UTF-8多字节字符编码由两类字节组成:起始字节和续作字节.
起步字节使用部分起步比特来表示后续的续行字节数,而其余比特则用于索引.
例如,在字节0xEC (11101100)中,4位前缀(1110)表示它开始三字节序列,而其余4位(1100)则携带索引信息.
接续字节有一个固定的2位前缀(10),并使用剩余的6位来携带索引信息.
因此,一个代码点的三字节UTF-8编码中的24个比特中只有16个包含索引信息.

blocks.en:
The larger code unit of 16-bits allows for more compact indexing compared to its 8-bit counterpart for certain code points.
Code points that would require three UTF-8 bytes can be instead represented as a single 16-bit unit (recall that code points in this range only use 16 bits for indexing).
The 16-bit unit can then be interpreted as a two-byte sequence Kim et al. (2026a) .
For our experiments, UTF-16 encodings will refer to the big-endian bytes obtained by splitting UTF-16 encodings in half.
We argue that splitting the 16 indexing bits to finer-grained units can be iteratively extended upon.
We propose two such encodings: Nybbles splits a 16-bit sequence into four nybbles (4-bit units) and Crumbs splits the 16-bit sequence into eight crumbs (2-bit units) 3 3 3 For Tamil script, we encode characters as 3 nybbles or 6 crumbs, since the first 4-bits are always zero. .
Finer-grained units reduce the base vocabulary size (from 256 symbols for bytes to 16 for nybbles and 4 for crumbs) at the cost of longer sequences (from 2 to 4 to 8 units per code unit).

blocks.en: 3.2 Language-specific Encodings

blocks.en:
We examine four languages that use different writing systems: Chinese (logography), Korean (syllabary) 4 4 4 Korean Hangul has been described as an alphabetic syllabary Pae (2011) , and has characteristics of an alphabet, syllabary, and logography Taylor (1980) . We consider it to be closest to a syllabary in the context of text processing, since it is most commonly represented as syllable units in Unicode. , Tamil (abugida), and Georgian (alphabet).
For each language, we source various representational methods, including legacy encodings and orthography-aware representations.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Legacy Encodings
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 遗产编码

blocks.en:
Prior to the wide adoption of Unicode, text encodings were designed to compactly represent the characters used in a target language, but they did not cover all other scripts.
When languages have large character inventories, such as Chinese and Korean, language-specific encodings like GBK for Chinese ideographs and CP949 and Johab for Korean Hangul use two bytes to represent characters.
When character inventories are sufficiently small, language-specific encodings can assign a single byte to each character, as GEOSTD8 and TSCII do for the Georgian and Tamil scripts, respectively.
We note that byte-level models using such single-byte encodings are equivalent to training on character-level granularity.
Therefore, rather than testing these encodings directly, we evaluate the general strategy of Character -level encoding, applying it to all four languages regardless of character inventory size.
blocks.zh:
在广泛采用Unicode之前,文本编码被设计成紧凑地代表了目标语言中使用的字符,但它们并没有覆盖所有其他脚本.
当语言有较大的字符目录时,如汉语和韩语,汉语的GBK等语言特有编码用于汉语象形文字和CP949,而朝鲜汉语的Johab则使用两个字节来代表字符.
当字符目录足够小时,语言特有编码可以为每个字符指定一个字节,如GEOSTD8和TSCII分别对格鲁吉亚文和泰米尔文.
我们注意到,使用这种单字节编码的字节级模型相当于关于字符级颗粒性的培训.
因此,我们不是直接测试这些编码,而是评价"字符-级别编码"的一般策略,不管字符目录大小,都应用到所有四种语言上.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Orthography-aware Representations
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 具有矫正学认识的代表

blocks.en: Drawing on prior work, we explore representation methods that exploit the orthographic structure of three scripts. To our knowledge, there are no script-specific encodings for Georgian.
blocks.zh: 我们借鉴以前的工作,探索利用三个脚本的正字结构的表述方法. 据我们所知,格鲁吉亚没有具体的文字编码。

blocks.en:
The Chinese Hanzi script (mainly CJK Ideographs in Unicode) contain rich features, such as phonetic information and glyph information ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Si et al., 2023 ; Xiang and Liu, 2025 ) .
However, methods based on these features are often not suitable to encode characters, as they require explicit symbols for character boundaries or disambiguation.
We experiment with character representations utilizing Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) decomposition, which represents a character by its subcharacters and their arrangement ( Han et al., 2021 ) .
For instance, the character 悬 is decomposed to (⿱, 县, 心).
IDS sequences are self-delimiting and rarely require disambiguation, making them a viable method for character representation.
The IDS subcharacters are often also decomposable, allowing for recursive decomposition.
In the previous decomposition, subcharacter 心 has no further decompositions, but 县 can be further decomposed to (⿱, 且, and 厶).
Allowing one decomposition step ( IDS-1 ) reduces the vocabulary size from 20,902 to 3,006 and allowing two steps of decomposition ( IDS-2 ) reduces it further to 1,138.
Characters with identical decompositions are rare (20 in IDS-1 and 24 in IDS-2), and are addressed by a single additional disambiguation symbol.
This representation benefits from subcharacter information transferring across multiple characters, but may suffer from long and irregular encoding lengths.
We use the cjkvi-ids database 5 5 5 https://github.com/cjkvi/cjkvi-ids for IDS decompositions.

The Korean Hangul script (Hangul Syllables) have a compositional structure, where each character can be canonically decomposed into three sub-character alphabet units called jamo ( Stratos, 2017 ; Moon and Okazaki, 2020 ; Cognetta et al., 2023 ) . \koreanfont For instance, the character 강 ( gang ) can be losslessly decomposed into jamos that carry phonetic information: ㄱ ( g ), ㅏ ( a ), ㅇ ( -ng ).
Jamo decomposition of Hangul syllables can be expressed as ( c h , c v , c t ) (c_{h},c_{v},c_{t}) with c h ∈ J h c_{h}\in J_{h} , c v ∈ J v c_{v}\in J_{v} , and c t ∈ J t c_{t}\in J_{t} where | J h | = 19 , | J v | = 21 , | J t | = 28 |J_{h}|=19,|J_{v}|=21,|J_{t}|=28 .
We test two variants of jamo-based encoding schemes.
The first, Jamo (fixed-length), always decomposes characters into three jamos (e.g. 하 → \rightarrow (ㅎ, ㅏ, ∅ \emptyset )), while the second Jamo-varlen encodes into two jamos whenever possible (e.g. 하 → \rightarrow (ㅎ, ㅏ)) 6 6 6 The null character does not exist in this variant, therefore | J t | = 27 |J_{t}|=27 . .
The former may benefit from the regularity of a fixed length encoding, while the latter may benefit from stronger compression.

blocks.en:
For abugida writing systems such as Tamil, a single user-perceived character (grapheme) may be encoded as multiple Unicode characters ( Velayuthan and Sarveswaran, 2024 ; Nisfer et al., 2026 ) .
For instance, the word \tamilfont வீடு ( veedu , ‘house’) is rendered as two graphemes \tamilfont வீ ( vee ) and \tamilfont டு ( du ), but is stored as four Unicode characters ( \tamilfont ’வ’, ’ீ’, ’ட’, ’ு’).
Following this prior work, we represent Tamil text at the Graphemes granularity, which better aligns with the units perceived by Tamil readers.
We follow the implementation of Nisfer et al. (2026) , which defines a total of 314 total graphemes, including 247 standard Tamil letters, 65 Grantha forms, and 2 conjunct graphemes ( \tamilfont ஶ்ரீ, க்ஷ).

blocks.en: 3.3 CuTF: Customized UTFs
blocks.zh: 3.3 CUTF: 自定义UTF

blocks.en:
Generally, existing encodings are designed with the constraint of using computational units (i.e. bytes) as code units.
Using these encodings for language modeling unnecessarily inherits these constraints, leading to inefficient indexing.
We propose CuTF (Customized UTF; Figure 2 A), a novel indexing scheme that encodes a target Unicode block using the minimum base units needed to index all codepoints in a target Unicode block at fixed lengths, relaxing the assumption that the total vocabulary of the encoding must fit within one byte (256 values).
blocks.zh:
一般来说,已存在的编码在设计上受到使用计算单位(即字节)作为代码单位的制约.
使用这些编码进行语言建模不必要地继承了这些限制,导致索引效率低下.
我们提出CUTF(自定义UTF;图2 A),这是一种新颖的索引方案,它使用一个目标Unicode块所需的最小基数单位来编码一个目标Unicode块中固定长度的所有编码点,放松了编码的总词汇必须符合一个字节(256个值)的假设.

blocks.en:
Each CuTF implementation is parameterized by an encoding length L L (denoted CuTF-L ), the number of units needed to represent a character in the target Unicode block. Specifically, the character is represented as a fixed-length
sequence of L L units [ c 1 , … , c L ] [c_{1},\ldots,c_{L}] , where the i i -th unit is drawn
from a position-specific vocabulary C i C_{i} . Indexing within this encoding uses the offset within the target block rather than the Unicode codepoint. 7 7 7 For instance, instead of indexing ‘ \koreanfont 강’ as the 44,053rd character in Unicode, CuTF indexes it as the 21st character in the Hangul Syllables block.

For instance, the 11,172 characters in the Hangul Syllables blocks can be mapped with three encoding units if each unit has 23 unique values.
In our experiments, we use L = 2 , 3 , 4 L=2,3,4 for larger script inventories ( ZH , KO ) and L = 2 , 3 L=2,3 for smaller scripts ( TA , KA ).

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We investigate the effectiveness of alternative encoding strategies (Section 3 ) for monolingual language modeling by training comparable language models that vary only in their encoding method for the target script. We train each language’s models on identical monolingual corpora for one epoch, introducing hybrid encoding schemes and character-level macro-averaged metrics to prevent out-of-vocabulary confounds and frequency biases in our evaluations, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们通过培训可比较的语言模型来调查单语言模型的替代编码策略(第3节)的有效性,这些模型只在目标脚本的编码方法上有所不同. 我们把每种语言的模型训练在一个时代的单一语言公司,引入混合编码办法和字符级宏观平均度量法,以防止在评估中出现省外混乱和频率偏差。

blocks.en:
Even in monolingual text corpora, characters outside the primary script (e.g. foreign words, symbols, emojis) can naturally occur. However,
many language-specific encodings do not provide full coverage of Unicode characters, leading to inconsistent handling of out-of-script characters across the considered settings. To in order to include the language-specific encodings while not introducing confounds, we propose Aether tokenizers, which apply a script-specific encoding only to the target script, while using UTF-8 as a back-off encoding for other characters (Fig 2 B); this hybrid encoding set up enables fair comparison between encoding methods in their ability to represent a target script, without out-of-vocabulary issues.
A preprocessing regex separates target from non-target text to facilitate the selective application of encodings across inputs.
The target and fallback encoding spaces are stored in separate inventories, preventing cross-script collisions in model inputs.
blocks.zh:
即使在单语文字corpora中,主脚本以外的字符(如外语,符号,emojis)也可以自然地发生. 不过,
许多语言特有编码不能为Unicode字符提供全覆盖,导致整个被考虑的设置对出标字符的处理不一致. 为了包含语言特有编码而同时又不引入混淆,我们提议了以太活字代碼器,将脚本特有编码只应用到目标脚本上,同时使用UTF-8作为其他字符的后置编码(图2 B);这种混合编码设置可以使编码方法在能够代表目标脚本时进行公平比较,而无需使用出站出站出站出站出站出局.
预处理正则ex将目标与非目标文本区分开来,以便于在输入中选择性地应用编码.
目标与倒回编码空格被存储在单独的目录中,防止了模型输入中的交叉标注相撞.

blocks.en:
For each encoding scheme, we train GPT2-base-sized decoder-only models with Llama-3 architecture from scratch, increasing sequence length from 512 to 4096 to account for longer sequences from finer-grained tokenization.
We use a maximum learning rate of 5e-4 at batch sizes of 64 using BF16 mixed precision training.
Additional hyperparameter information can be found in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
对于每一个编码方案,我们从零开始用Llama-3架构来训练出GPT2-base大小的解码器唯一的模型,将序列长度从512个增加到4096个,以计入从更细的地标化产生的较长序列.
我们采用5e-4的最高学习率,分批64分,使用BF16混合精密训练.
其他超参数信息见附录A。

blocks.en:
Importantly, we train each model on one epoch, so that all models of the same language are trained on the same amount of data regardless of input sequence lengths.
Ensuring fair comparisons between models with different tokenizers is difficult, since runs cannot be both compute-matched ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and data-matched ( Park et al., 2020 ) at the same time.
We focus on data-matching over compute-matching in our experiments as it controls for the overall information seen by each model, while compute-matching benefits more compressive encodings artificially by allowing it to train on significantly more data.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,我们每个模型在一个时代进行训练,这样,所有同一种语言的模型,无论输入序列长度大小,都会接受同样数量数据的培训.
确保模型与不同标注符之间的公平比较是困难的,因为运行不能同时进行计算比对(刘等,2025年)和数据比对(朴等,2020年)。
我们在实验中注重数据比对过量的计算比对,因为它控制着每个模型所看到的总体信息,而计算比对则通过允许它训练出大量的数据,在人工中更能进行压缩编码。

blocks.en:
Each model is trained on a high-quality, curated pretraining text corpus for the target language.
For Chinese, we use FineWeb-Edu-Chinese-v2 from the OpenCSG Corpus ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .
For Korean, we use the LLM pretraining corpus from the AI Hub 8 8 8 https://www.aihub.or.kr/aihubdata/data/view.do?dataSetSn=71748 .
For Tamil, we use the Tamil subset from the Sangraha dataset ( Khan et al., 2024 ) .
For Georgian, we use the Georgian subset from the FineWeb2 dataset ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) .
Each training corpus is capped to approximately 6 billion characters, corresponding to around 15 billion UTF-8 bytes for each language.
For comparison, this exceeds the 7–11 billion UTF-8 byte range (varying by language) recommended for our model size by tokenization scaling laws ( Limisiewicz et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
每个模型都接受针对目标语言的高质量、精准的预训文本集的培训。
对于中文,我们使用来自OpenCSG Corpus的FineWeb-Edu-Chinese-v2(Yu等,2025).
对于韩语,我们使用AI Hub 8 8 8的LLM预训书 https://www.aihub.or.kr/aihubdata/data/view.do?dataSetSn=71748 。 。 。 。
对泰米尔人来说,我们使用Sangraha数据集(Khan等人,2024年)中的泰米尔子集。
对于格鲁吉亚,我们使用FineWeb2数据集(Penedo等人,2025年)中的格鲁吉亚子集。
每个训练大纲的上限为约60亿个字符,相当于每种语言约150亿个UTF-8字节.
相比之下,这超过了通过标注缩放定律(Limisiewicz等,2026年)为我们的模型尺寸建议的7至110亿UTF-8字节范围(按语言变化)。

blocks.en: For each setting, we report mean and standard deviation from 5 random seeds.
blocks.zh: 对于每个设定,我们报告5个随机种子的平均值和标准偏差。

blocks.en:
For evaluation, we use language modeling probabilities of sequences taken from the FLORES dataset ( Goyal et al., 2022 ) .
Our aim is to evaluate an encoding’s ability to effectively represent all targeted characters in a script.
However, common characters are more frequent than uncommon characters by large magnitudes ( Choi, 2000 ; Liu et al., 2017 ) , skewing standard language modeling metrics to a small subset of characters.
Therefore, we propose character-level macro averaged negative log-likelihood ( Macro NLL ) as our primary metric. Individual token NLLs are aggregated to the character-level 9 9 9 For Tamil, it is aggregated to the grapheme-level. and averaged across character occurrences; then, the log-likelihood values of all unique characters are averaged together with equal weighting regardless of frequency.
For experimental results with the standard bits-per-character loss, refer to Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
在评价时,我们使用语言模型来模拟取自FLORES数据集的序列概率(Goyal等,2022年)。
我们的目标是评估编码在剧本中有效代表所有目标角色的能力。
然而,常见的人物比出众的人物更频繁地出现于大尺度(Choi, 2000;Liu等, 2017),将标准语言的模型化度量衡切入到一个小子集的人物.
因此,我们提议将字符级宏观平均值负对数(Macro NLL)作为我们的首要衡量标准。 单个代币NLL被归为字符级9-9 9 对于泰米尔语,被归为图形级. 然后,所有独特字符的日志相像值,无论频率如何,均以等重值进行平均。
对于具有标准比特/特征损失的实验结果,参见附录B.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows log-linear fits between the compression of an encoding and its language modeling performance.
Since all models for a given language are trained on the same data for one epoch, we measure compression as the number of training steps per epoch.
We observe two distinct trends between languages.
blocks.zh:
图3显示一个编码的压缩与其语言建模性能相匹配的日志行.
由于特定语言的所有模型都是在一个时代的相同数据上训练的,所以我们测量压缩为每个时代的训练步骤数.
我们观察到两种语言之间的明显趋势。

blocks.en:
Encoding compression was significantly correlated with language modeling performance, with more compressive encodings performing better.
The correlation was strong for Chinese ( r = 0.911 r=0.911 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and moderately strong for Korean ( r = 0.689 r=0.689 , p = 0.013 p=0.013 ).
We note that the weaker correlation for Korean was largely driven by the Jamo encoding.
Excluding it yields a correlation comparable to Chinese ( r = 0.886 r=0.886 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Why does encoding choice impact Chinese and Korean but not (significantly) Tamil and Georgian?
We attribute this difference to orthographic granularity , or how densely languages represent linguistic content in writing ( Shani et al., 2026 ) .
In Chinese, each character typically corresponds to a morpheme, and in Korean, each character encodes a full syllable.
In contrast, characters in Tamil and Georgian correspond to individual consonants or vowels, which contain little information in isolation.
Consistent with this, Chinese and Korean require less than half as many characters as Tamil and Georgian to express the same content in our evaluation data (Figure 4 ).
We hypothesize that when characters contain substantial information, allowing models to reconstruct this information in fewer steps (fewer tokens) is beneficial for performance.
Conversely, when characters carry negligible information on their own, characters and subcharacters perform similarly.
blocks.zh:
为什么编码选择会影响中国人和韩国人,
我们把这种差异归结为正文颗粒性,或者在文字中语言密度如何代表语言内容(Shani等人,2026年)。
在汉语中,每个字符一般对应一个摩耳音;在韩语中,每个字符编码一个完整的音节.
相比之下,泰米尔语和格鲁吉亚语中的字符对应的是个别相通或元音,这些相通或元音在孤立中包含的信息很少.
因此,中国和韩国在评价数据(图4)中表示相同内容时,需要的字符少于泰米尔和格鲁吉亚的一半。
我们假设,当字符包含大量信息时,让模型在更少的步子(fewers sorders)中重建这些信息是有利于性能的.
反之,当人物自己携带可忽略不计的信息时,人物和分形者也表现类似.

blocks.en:
Tokenizer compression has been said to be correlated with model performance Gallé (2019) ; Goldman et al. (2024) , but there is conflicting evidence Schmidt et al. (2024) .
It may be the case that longer sequences from finer-grained tokenization are advantageous, as this allows models to spend more FLOPs on a given text Xue et al. (2022) ; Marathe et al. (2026) . Limisiewicz et al. (2026) find increasing compression past an optimal point can harm performance.
Our findings suggest that the role of compression can be heavily dependent on the language.

For Korean models, the best performing Jamo encoding outperformed the most compressive encoding (Character).
Jamo encoding decomposes each syllable into three jamos, a meaningful sub-character unit that can capture linguistic phenomena such as morphophonological alternations ( Kim et al., 2026b ) .
In contrast, Jamo-varlen, which uses the same sub-character units but with variable-length sequences, did not show the same benefits and instead performed in line with its compression.
Similarly, IDS-1 and IDS-2 also performed in line with their compression, despite using linguistically informative subcharacter units ( Han et al., 2021 ) as variable-length sequences.
This suggests that sub-character information is only useful in settings where it is paired with fixed-length encoding patterns.

blocks.en:
Recent work argues that tokenization should be considered as a core design decision appropriately tailored for its context ( Alqahtani et al., 2026 ) .
Encodings, much like subword tokenizers, have desiderata that should be considered before being deployed in the language modeling pipeline.
Even without performance benefits, compression is a desirable quality for efficient model training and inference.
However, higher compression often necessitates a larger vocabulary size (as seen in Table 1 ).
Our findings on when and how compression affects performance can help inform these tradeoffs when choosing an encoding.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作认为,应当将标志化视为一项适合其背景的核心设计决定(Alqahtani等,2026年)。
编码与子词代碼相去甚远,在部署在语言建模管道之前,应该先考虑这些代碼.
即使没有性能效益,压缩也是高效的模型培训和推论的一种理想品质.
然而,更高的压缩往往需要更大的词汇大小(如表1所显示).
我们对于压缩何时以及如何影响性能的发现,有助于在选择编码时为这些取舍提供信息.

blocks.en:
Another factor is encoding fairness between scripts.
Our approach of using hybrid encodings of Aether tokenization poses a solution to encoding length disparities in UTF-8 ( Land and Arnett, 2025 ; Arnett et al., 2024 ) .
Hybrid encodings provide a method to improve compression or performance at the cost of increased vocabulary size.
blocks.zh:
另一个因素是在脚本之间编码公平.
我们使用以太符号化混合编码的方法为UTF-8(Land and Arnett, 2025; Arnett等, 2024)中的长度差异提供了编码解决方案.
混合编码提供了以增加词汇大小为代价来改进压缩或性能的方法.

blocks.en:
We argue that understanding the effect of encoding choice is relevant for all tokenizers.
All modern subword tokenization models (byte-level BPE, and even character-level BPE or Unigram with byte fallback) implicitly use UTF-8 encoding as a pretokenizer, which has tangible and underlooked effects on the final tokenization ( Velayuthan and Sarveswaran, 2024 ; Gorman and Pinter, 2025 ) .
Our work suggests that the default UTF-8 encoding used by subword tokenizers may disadvantage certain scripts with longer byte lengths, since specialized encodings can provide increased compression and improved language modeling performance. This effect might be the most significant for languages with coarser orthographic granularities like Korean and Chinese.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,理解编码选择的效果对于所有标注器都是相关的.
所有现代的子词符号化模型(byte-level BPE,甚至字符级 BPE 或 有字节倒置的Unigram)都含蓄地使用UTF-8编码作为前置编码器,对最终的符号化具有有形和被忽略的影响(Velayuthan and Sarveswaran, 2024; Gorman and Pinter, 2025).
我们的工作表明,子词代碼器使用的默认UTF-8编码可能会使某些字节长度较长的脚本处于不利地位,因为专门的编码可以提供更高的压缩并改进语言建模性能. 这种影响对于具有相近正体分泌物如韩文和中文等语言来说可能最为显著.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate alternative encoding schemes for their impact on language modeling performance.
We conduct a comprehensive analysis of encoding effects on 38 language-encoding settings, considering Unicode-based encodings, language-specific encodings, and our novel encoding scheme, CuTF, that efficiently encodes the target script at a chosen compression rate.
To facilitate full coverage of possible characters in language-specific encoding experiments, we also introduce Aether Tokenization, a new hybrid encoding method that can reap the benefits of specialized encodings without sacrificing character coverage.
We find that byte-level language models benefit from compressive text encodings for languages with coarse orthographic granularity (such as Chinese and Korean), while languages with finer granularity (such as Tamil and Georgian) are largely insensitive to encoding choice.
In light of these results, we argue that practitioners should not default to UTF-8 when building a language model, but instead treat the choice of encoding as a deliberate design decision that considers the targeted languages.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们调查替代编码方案对语言建模性能的影响.
我们综合分析编码对38个语言编码设置的影响,考虑基于Unicode的编码,语言特有编码,以及我们的新编编码方案CUTF,以所选压缩速率高效地编码目标脚本.
为了方便在语言特有编码实验中完全覆盖可能的字符,我们还引入了Aether Tokenization,这是一种新的混合编码方法,可以在不牺牲字符覆盖的情况下从专门编码中获得好处.
我们发现,字节级语言模型受益于粗正体分泌地(如中文和韩文)语言的压缩文本编码,而细粒地(如泰米尔语和格鲁吉亚语)语言对编码选择基本不敏感。
鉴于这些结果,我们主张从业者在构建语言模型时不应默认UTF-8,而是将编码的选择作为考虑被目标语言的刻意设计决定.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Given the computational costs of comprehensively analyzing multiple encoding schemes across languages and modeling runs, the models considered in this work are relatively small, at approximately 120M parameters. Scaling these experiments in future work will be important for verifying our results, particularly on downstream tasks beyond next-word prediction. Additionally, our evaluation is currently limited to monolingual settings, though we hypothesize that encoding effects may behave differently in multilingual settings due to cross-script interactions and the availability of alternative encodings for different languages.
blocks.zh: 鉴于全面分析多种语言的编码计划和模型运行的计算成本,这项工作所考虑的模型相对较小,大约为120M参数. 在今后的工作中扩大这些试验,对于核实我们的成果,特别是在下字预测之外的下游任务方面,将是重要的。 此外,我们的评价目前仅限于单一语言的设置,尽管我们假设,由于交叉标注的相互作用以及不同语言的替代编码的可用性,编码效果在多语言环境中可能表现不同。

blocks.en: Finally, like standard byte-level language models using UTF-8, models trained on our custom encodings can generate invalid or malformed sequences ( Moon et al., 2026 ; Firestone et al., 2025 ) , an issue we leave unaddressed in this paper. We anticipate that some encoding schemes may be particuarly prone to this issue, such as IDS tokenization, that would require the model to precisely match long, variable-length sequences for each character when generating new text.
blocks.zh: 最后,与使用UTF-8的标准字节级语言模型一样,接受过自定义编码培训的模型可能生成无效或畸形的序列(Moon等,2026;Firestone等,2025),这个问题在本文中未解决. 我们预计,有些编码办法可能部分地容易引起这一问题,例如IDS符号化,这就要求模型在生成新文本时,对每个字符的长而可变的序列进行精确的匹配.

blocks.en:
The hyperparameters of our models are found in Table 2 .
For hyperparameter search, we performed a sweep over 1e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3 learning rate on three encodings (UTF-8, Jamo, and GBK) on Chinese and Korean.
Higher learning rate values would produce better training curves, but were frequently prone to training loss spikes.
The 5e-4 value was chosen for our experiments, but occasional training loss spikes persisted.
Increasing batch size (64 → \rightarrow 128) improved stability but harmed performance.
Eventually, changing β 2 \beta_{2} value of the AdamW optimizer from the default 0.999 value to 0.95 improved both stability and performance.
